ORDER
On August 30, 2019, Entergy Arkansas, LLC (EAL) and the General Staff (Staff)
of the Arkansas Public Service Commission (Commission) filed their Joint Motion to
Approve Settlement and Cancel Hearing (Joint Motion). EAL and Staff state that they
have reached agreement on all outstanding issues in this proceeding and detail the
resolution of each. They recommend that the Commission waive the remainder of the
procedural schedule, cancel the hearing, and decide the case based on the existing
record. They also state that the only intervenor, Arkansas Electric Energy Consumers,
has stated that it does not oppose the Joint Motion. Joint Motion K117-9.
Having reviewed the Joint Motion, and on the basis of the representation of EAL
and Staff that all outstanding issues have been resolved, the Commission grants the
Joint Motion to Cancel Hearing.
The hearing scheduled for 9:30 a.m. on Tuesday,
September 10 2019, is hereby cancelled and all witnesses are excused from appearing
therein.
EAL's and Staffs request to approve the settlement will be addressed by a
subsequent Order.
